operating_entities.note: The page says each subsidiary is 'direct or indirect wholly owned' but does not give the intermediate chain (the 10-K shows PLICC held via Primerica Financial Services (Canada) Ltd.), so parent is shown as Primerica, Inc. for all. Third parties named on the page (Canada Life, Canada Protection Plan Inc./Foresters Life, Surex.com, 8Twelve Mortgage, Answer Financial, LegalShield, American Bankers Insurance Co. of Florida) are counterparties, not Primerica entities, and are excluded. The about-primerica.html footnote repeats the three life companies and the two investment dealers. The Canadian site primerica.ca could not be reached from this session (host not in the allowed network list; proxy 502), so its own Canadian legal page was not checked.

cio.name: Tracy X. Tan
cio.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, Primerica, Inc. (no Chief Investment Officer title exists; CFO oversees treasury and capital markets, and the senior-management investment committee supervises the third-party investment advisor)
cio.prior: CFO, Strategic Link Consulting (2018-2023); SVP & CFO, Assurant Global Housing (2015-2018); VP Finance & divisional CFO, Novelis North America (2013-2015); VP & divisional CFO, Southwire (2005-2013); General Electric (1996-2005)
cio.tenure_source: company bio (investors.primerica.com management page); press release (Business Wire 2023-09-14)
cio.note: Designated most senior investment officer by remit: bio says she 'oversees all aspects of the Company's finance function ... including planning and analysis, controllership, investor relations, treasury, tax, and capital markets'. FY2025 10-K: 'We have an investment committee composed of members of our senior management team that is responsible for establishing and maintaining our investment guidelines and supervising our investment activity ... We use a third-party investment advisor to assist us in the management of our investing activities. Our investment advisor reports to our investment committee.' Committee members and the advisor are not named (Conning, Inc. signed as 'Investment Manager' for Primerica Life Insurance Company in a 2014 SEC exhibit; not confirmed current). Canadian-dollar assets backing Primerica Life Canada are held inside this group construct; there is no Canadian investment team. industry_since = 2015 (first insurance role, Assurant); comp kept from first-round file (2026 proxy).
